title: SC issues notice to Congress, AAP, AISA over traders' plea against Delhi protests

ai.summary: The Supreme Court issued notices to Congress, AAP, and AISA following traders' bodies' amended plea claiming Delhi protests impacted their businesses.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court issued notices to Congress, Cockroach Janta Party, AAP and AISA
facts.quote: The Supreme Court on Wednesday issued notices to Congress, Cockroach Janta Party, AAP and AISA after taking note of an amended plea by traders' bodies alleging that their businesses were affected by protests held in Delhi.
